recovery.codesIntro: If you cannot access your phone and email, you use one of these codes when signing in. Each code can be used only once. Codes are shown only once, at the moment they are generated; print them or store them somewhere safe.
recovery.codesShownTitle: Your new recovery codes (they will not be shown again):
recovery.savedCheck: I have saved the codes somewhere safe.
recovery.regenWarning: If you generate new codes, all of your old codes become invalid.
recovery.emailIntro: If you cannot access your old email address, set a new address here. For security, you must have signed in by phone (QR) or with a recovery code, enter your password and verify the code sent to the new address. Your clients and records are not affected.
recovery.emailNeedsStrong: This session was opened with an email code. To change the address, sign out and sign in by phone (QR) or with a recovery code.
recovery.emailSendCode: Send code to the new address
recovery.phoneWaiting: Phone change pending: {model} {code} will be revoked automatically when the new phone is activated (valid until {date}). Start device registration in the app on your new phone; administrator approval is required.
recovery.proofIntro: You approved this session with {model}. When your new phone is activated with administrator approval, this phone is revoked automatically.
recovery.phoneBegin: Replace this phone with a new one
recovery.phoneHelp: If you still have your old phone: sign out, sign in with QR approval on the old phone and start the change from this section within 30 minutes. If you no longer have the old phone, close it with Revoke in the list above; register the new phone from the app (administrator approval is required).
recovery.ownerIntro: Unused offline codes: <count>{n}</count>. The kit is generated only from the database (SQL) console and is kept offline, on paper. When someone signs in with an offline code, all other Owner sessions are closed.

pairing.title: Make your phone a trusted device
pairing.p1: Pairing can only be done from the Yaşam Sistemi Android app on your phone. Open the app and tap this link from within the app.
pairing.p2: After pairing, your administrator will call you on your registered number; you will read out the code on your screen.

approve.title: Sign-in approval
approve.p1: This QR code can only be approved with the Yaşam Sistemi Android app on your phone. If the app is installed and your phone is paired, scan the QR code again with your phone's camera.
approve.p2: This page cannot approve a sign-in. If you did not start the sign-in request, do nothing.

sessionBind.title: Link the session to your phone
sessionBind.p1: This can only be done in the Yaşam Sistemi Android app on your phone, with a paired trusted phone. There is nothing to do in the browser.

session.title: Your Session Has Ended

session.line2: Sign in again to continue where you left off.

membership.line2: Please contact your administrator to access the modules.
